sources.title: Government Functional Standard GovS 002: Project delivery (HTML)
sources.author: Government Project Delivery; version 2.1, September 2025
sources.type: primary institutional or first-party professional guidance
sources.sections: Sections 8.2–8.3 and 8.6–8.10: quality, requirements, verification/validation, transition, ownership and lessons
sources.supported_use: Separate requirements, checking, acceptance and transition ownership.
sources.limits: Selected sections only, not the full standard, linked Teal Book or ISO material. Original project is not government-standard conformance.

sources.title: Tool: Handoff
sources.author: Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality; reviewed May 2023
sources.type: primary institutional or first-party professional guidance
sources.sections: Definition and How To Use a Handoff Effectively: clarity, acknowledgment, questions and uncertainty
sources.supported_use: Confirm shared understanding and receiving responsibility.
sources.limits: Clinical context; clinical duties and examples are not imported. No videos viewed, actual team assessment or effectiveness evidence for this paper exercise.

sources.title: Model for Improvement: Testing Changes
sources.author: Institute for Healthcare Improvement
sources.type: primary institutional or first-party professional guidance
sources.sections: PDSA overview, reasons to test, plan/do/study/act and tips about small tests and failed changes
sources.supported_use: Predict, observe outcomes and side effects, compare, revise or stop.
sources.limits: No clinical intervention or full improvement program is adopted. Suggestions about rapid testing do not bypass actual approval or privacy. Four original cases do not establish causality.

sources.title: Lifelong learning must become a strategic policy priority
sources.author: International Labour Organization; May 5, 2026
sources.type: primary institutional or first-party professional guidance
sources.sections: Changing skills landscape and Beyond digital and green skills, with access-to-learning discussion
sources.supported_use: Consider transferable foundations alongside changing tools and constraints.
sources.limits: News article only, not the full linked report or underlying studies/data. Statistics and forecasts are not imported; invented notices are not current market evidence.

sources.title: Step 2 – Describe the Program
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention; August 18, 2024
sources.type: primary institutional or first-party professional guidance
sources.sections: Overview, Developing a Logic Model, outputs and contextual factors
sources.supported_use: Distinguish activities, outputs, intended outcomes and context.
sources.limits: Selected action-guide section only, not the full evaluation framework or causal validation. Original schedule chain is not a public-health intervention.

sources.title: Knowledge Management
sources.author: NASA APPEL Knowledge Services
sources.type: primary institutional or first-party professional guidance
sources.sections: Overview on critical knowledge, context, lessons and continuity; identification of continuity resources
sources.supported_use: Preserve understandable critical knowledge for reuse and successors.
sources.limits: Overview only. Linked reports, policy and documentation templates were not inspected. Original paper process is not NASA-compliant or operationally qualified.

sources.title: Cost of Quality (COQ)
sources.author: American Society for Quality
sources.type: primary institutional or first-party professional guidance
sources.sections: Definitions of prevention, appraisal, internal and external failure costs
sources.supported_use: Ask whether effort prevents defects, checks essentials or repairs failure.
sources.limits: Selected definitions, not a cost model, quantitative optimum, book or certification standard. No permission to reduce required assurance.

sources.title: Worker.gov home and issue-routing directory
sources.author: U.S. Department of Labor Worker.gov
sources.type: primary institutional or first-party professional guidance
sources.sections: Issue categories, routing links and visible lapse/update notice
sources.supported_use: Find the relevant workplace-issue category and inspect freshness before relying on a route.
sources.limits: Retrieved page says updates were suspended and last update was February 2, 2026. Live service availability was not independently verified. Directory only, not a current wage, leave, classification, deadline or coverage ruling. Direct DOL and OSHA pages failed retrieval.

sources.title: Filing A Charge of Discrimination
sources.author: U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission
sources.type: primary institutional or first-party professional guidance
sources.sections: Inquiry/interview versus charge, time-limit warning, employer notification and distinct federal-employee process
sources.supported_use: Distinguish inquiry and formal filing and check the actual applicable process.
sources.limits: No personal coverage or deadline calculation; not a wage-hours ruling. Linked deadline and confidentiality subpages were not inspected, so no numeric deadline or anonymity guarantee is imported.

sources.title: Q&As on Business and Forced Labour
sources.author: International Labour Organization; historical conceptual resource
sources.type: primary institutional or first-party professional guidance
sources.sections: What is forced labour? definition and discussion of threatened penalties, voluntariness and indirect pressures
sources.supported_use: Examine meaningful choice and coercive dependence beyond task difficulty.
sources.limits: Selected conceptual section, not the full conventions, linked handbook, local law or case determination. No legal diagnosis, guaranteed remedy or instruction to resign.

sources.title: Employee Rights
sources.author: National Labor Relations Board
sources.type: primary institutional or first-party professional guidance
sources.sections: Union/nonunion activity, participation/refraining, Who is covered? exclusions and official information routes
sources.supported_use: Check sector and coverage before applying a U.S. labor-relations example.
sources.limits: Selected agency summary, not current public-sector law, a status ruling or protection for every act. Page announces September 25–28 maintenance; no deadline extension is inferred.

sources.title: Concerted Activity
sources.author: National Labor Relations Board
sources.type: primary institutional or first-party professional guidance
sources.sections: Opening explanation and warning that conduct can lose protection
sources.supported_use: Distinguish collective purpose from an unconditional promise of protection.
sources.limits: Brief federal guidance only, not a campaign plan or personal legal analysis. Must be read with coverage limits and current jurisdiction-matched advice.

sources.title: The ADA: Your Responsibilities as an Employer
sources.author: U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission; legacy publication with 2008-amendments notice
sources.type: primary institutional or first-party professional guidance
sources.sections: Header warning; How Are Essential Functions Determined? and adjustment examples
sources.supported_use: Distinguish a legitimate task outcome from a customary method.
sources.limits: Page carries an explicit 2008-amendments notice. Old disability definitions, historical thresholds, deadlines and procedural statements are not adopted as current law. Narrow conceptual use only, not an accommodation or hiring ruling.

sources.title: Management Standards – Demands
sources.author: UK Health and Safety Executive; updated May 11, 2021
sources.type: primary institutional or first-party professional guidance
sources.sections: Demands definition, achievable demands relative to agreed hours and local response to concerns
sources.supported_use: Consider workload, agreed hours and responsible organizational arrangements.
sources.limits: Narrow organizational principle, not a universal right to disconnect, clinical treatment or proof of a health effect. No linked guide or legal test is claimed read.
